svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step resist covers both active areas and leaves a window over a wide stack on the oxide-filled trench. After it the resist is gone and a thin oxide covers everything, as before the mask.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step resist covers both active areas and leaves a window over a wide stack on the oxide-filled trench. After it the resist is gone and a thin oxide covers everything, as before the mask.
svg.text: The implanted resist is ashed and the
wafer cleaned, sparing the spacer oxide.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
